assumptions.statement: The SITE_BOUNDARY and all three KEY_AREA polygons are provisional rough geometry, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All spatial layers, areas, figures and PDFs must be rebuilt when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Official regulatory controls, ownership, roads, rail, heritage, water, utilities and surveyed buildings are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: The proposal states performance intent only and makes no statutory, parcel, demolition or engineering conclusion.

assumptions.statement: Three dockyard footprints are reversible capacity envelopes rather than surveyed or approved buildings.
assumptions.impact: Footprint metrics cannot be converted into floor area, FAR, height or investment.

assumptions.statement: The service spine and handover stitches are relationship lines, not approved robot routes or road redlines.
assumptions.impact: Alignment, crossing form, access hours and operating domain require field, traffic, heritage and ownership review.

assumptions.statement: Fleet type, battery chemistry, charger interface, electrical capacity, ventilation, drainage, fire compartmentation and emergency access are unknown.
assumptions.impact: No charger count, kW, fire distance or storage capacity is proposed; specialists must establish these before any physical pilot.

assumptions.statement: Dock aprons and micro-docks show public-interface roles, not confirmed public ownership or available clear space.
assumptions.impact: Every location must preserve pedestrian, accessible, emergency and ordinary civic use before robot operations.

assumptions.statement: The green companion strip is an abstract design layer rather than mapped existing habitat or approved park boundary.
assumptions.impact: No parking, charging or fault isolation may be inferred inside actual protected green, water or heritage areas.

assumptions.statement: No fleet inventory, shift pattern, failure rate, worker demand, energy demand or lifecycle baseline has been supplied.
assumptions.impact: Operational targets remain proposed measurement fields and must be set only after an authorized baseline study.
